name: Galatea
source:
A living doll in the appearance of a young girl making her sudden arrival in [url=/c93183]Frederick[/url]'s apartment.
Widely known as "Ivory Maiden", unlike her peers, she is the only doll that possesses self-consciousness.
Her name, "Galatea", is taken after [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Galatea_(mythology)]a Greek mythology[/url].
